preconditions.description: The number of data centers n must be between 2 and 100,000.
The number of clients m must be between 1 and 100,000.
The day length h must be between 2 and 100,000.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= u_j < h for u_j in u)
preconditions.description: Each maintenance hour u_j must be a valid hour index within the day length h.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= c_i1 <= n and 1 <= c_i2 <= n and c_i1 != c_i2 for c_i1, c_i2 in clients)
preconditions.description: Each client's data center indices must be valid and distinct.

postconditions.description: The minimum number of data centers k to be included in the experiment must be between 1 and n.

postconditions.expression: len(set(x)) == k and all(1 <= x <= n for x in x)
postconditions.description: The output must contain k distinct data center indices within the valid range.

postconditions.expression: all(u[c_i1] != u[c_i2] for c_i1, c_i2 in clients)
postconditions.description: After shifting the maintenance times, the data of any client must remain accessible during any hour of the day.
